model.retry_policy: At most 20 HTTP attempts per logical call; all failures retained; no invalid-route retries beyond H

model.execution: Independent concurrent HTTP requests, not a padded local inference batch.

model.timing: Accepted-schema response latency excludes preceding failed requests; total wall/cost retained
